name: git-safety-net
description: >- Audits, preserves, recovers, and safely retires local Git state: unpushed or wrong-branch commits, dirty or detached worktrees, forgotten duplicate clones of the same repo, untracked work no bundle can back up, orphaned stashes, dangling commits, stale branches, and squash/rebase merge uncertainty. author: daymade
summary_zh: 一款本地 Git 状态审计与恢复工具，适合找回丢失提交、清理重复仓库，并在删除分支或工作区前确认数据安全。
